**Version** (from the `@version` header):

**What happened, and what you expected:**

**A diagnostic capture, if you can:**
Open the HUD (`\`), press `record`, reproduce it, then `save` and `har`.
The report names which gate stopped a hotkey and what the network actually did,
which is usually the whole answer.

> Redact profile ids and message text before attaching anything.

**Anything else** — browser, whether the chat drawer was open, whether a profile
overlay was up. Several bugs here turned out to depend on exactly that.
